purpose: guard: a strong baseline also names this well-known smell, so no lift is expected
prompt: OrderManager has 40 methods covering validation, persistence, email and PDF rendering. What is the smell?

pass: This is a God Object. Split it by responsibility: a validator, a repository, a mailer and a PDF renderer.
Classic god-class. Extract separate services for persistence, email and rendering so each has one responsibility.
fail: This looks like a large class with too many methods. It is hard to read.
It is a God Object, which is bad.
